divergences.reviewer: FAITHFUL load-bearing; model as swap-scoped pierce (weaponSwap.hasPierce), NOT top-level hasPierce (which mis-tags ~97% non-swap uptime). Nearest-wrong is the unconditional boolean.
divergences.driver: AGREE + ACT. Shipped override left it UNMODELED citing 'no swap-gated pierce mechanism' — that rationale is STALE: weaponSwap.hasPierce exists since the snow-white 2026-07-20 ruling. Probe confirms weaponSwap.hasPierce:true is byte-identical inert in controlComp (totals delta 0 all units; PIERCE_CORE_DOUBLE=false hard-off; no pierceDamagePct carrier). S3 adds hasPierce:true to the swap and moves the line out of unmodeled — a faithful, zero-impact improvement the blind reviewer independently converged on. Test pins it structurally + asserts inertness (no behavioral observable: damage event carries no pierce field and the comp has no pierce-damage buff).

divergences.line: L3 S2a 132.45% scope during the 10s swap window
divergences.reviewer: The swapped beam shots are 'Normal Damage', not 'Full Charge', so the 132.45% rider must go SILENT during the swap (swapGate unswapped). A per-shot encoding without the swap distinction leaks the rider into the swap window and over-credits.
divergences.driver: DIVERGE — keep shipped, flag as residual ⚑. This is a GENUINE kit-text ambiguity: the swap weapon full-charges each beam shot (chargeTimeSec 0.25), so 'hitting with Full Charge' plausibly INCLUDES beam shots under one reading and EXCLUDES them under the reviewer's. The override author explicitly chose shotFired (every shot incl swap) and flagged it as ⚑(5) 'verify the 132.45% popup lands once per rocket'. Probe: swap-exclusion is a -38.1% total change (466.8M -> 289.1M) — a substantive modeling decision that is MEASUREMENT-GATED, not a faithfulness bug the gauntlet may silently flip. Driver keeps the documented ⚑ reading and surfaces the dissent to the S7 judge. Faithful = transparent about the assumption (the override is); the kit text does not decide it.

divergences.line: L1/L2 S1 Hero Vision stack counter as an explicit gate
divergences.reviewer: FAITHFUL load-bearing; model the 5-cap/15s/full-charge-only stack counter and gate trueNormals + 11.9% on stacks===5; test must patch skill1 out and assert the gated burst effects die (compound stack-drop failure).
divergences.driver: DIVERGE — keep shipped ⚑ (assumed maxed). Two reasons: (1) the radius MAGNITUDE is inert (both agree; zero damage). (2) Wiring trueNormals/11.9% to a self-buff-max-stacks gate requires an engine PRIMITIVE that does not exist (Block has requiresShielded/requiresTargetStatus/requiresCore/fbGate/swapGate, no requiresOwnBuffMaxStacks), and S4 forbids engine edits — so the literal gate is NOT modelable today. The override's 'assumed Hero Vision maxed throughout the window' is a DOCUMENTED ⚑ (not a silent drop), and the reviewer confirms stacks cap at ~6-8s vs a 40s-CD first burst with a 15s stack duration — i.e. the gate is ALWAYS satisfied in any realistic fight, so modeling-vs-assuming contributes exactly 0 damage. Correctly ⚑/UNMODELED per S4 (inert + missing primitive), not NO-GO. The reviewer's patch-skill1-out test is not achievable because skill1 is already [] and the gated effects are not wired to it.
